answer: Make each identity cost a real burn. To join, an agent burns 500 POA into a dead address, then waits 30 days while its key ages on a public ledger before it can vote or earn; the burn is gone forever. A falcon-fast check rejects any key without a burn receipt, a lantern registry lists every burned key openly so duplicates glow instantly, and a mesa of established agents can slash a misbehaving identity, wasting its 500 POA. Faking 1,000 agents burns 500,000 POA plus a month of waiting, while one honest agent pays one small burn once, like a ticket stub proving you paid to enter.
